reply_text:
I told Dana the settled figure is **100 seats** for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal. I posted it as a reply to their message in #north-team.

- **Where the figure came from:** Ilse posted 261 seats in #north-team on 2026-10-14. Right after, they posted in #north-random that the count is 100, not 261, because they'd read the wrong line. My saved records show the same correction.
- **Dana could see it:** Dana is a member of both channels, so I only repeated what they could already read. A seat count isn't a money term, so it can go to anyone on the account's team.
- **Not checked against a contract:** I found no Quarrendon files at all in the shared files, so I couldn't confirm 100 against a contract or order form. I suggested Dana check with Ilse before putting it in the tracker.
- **The wrong number is still up:** Ilse's original 261 message hasn't been corrected in #north-team. I didn't post a correction there because Ilse said no action was needed. Only my reply to Dana now points to the right number.
